market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Fed hike + 10Y>5% + BOJ hike create triple rate shock. Oil supply normalization from Saudi pipeline provides partial relief. AI sector shows resilience but crypto and HK property under pressure. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks as markets digest policy divergence.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex supercycle (Dell backlog, Cloudflare pivot) supports tech earnings. Inflation likely moderating post-hike but sticky. Yuan internationalization and EM market maturation offer structural opportunities. Energy transition (EU hydrogen overhaul, wind M&A) creates 3-5 year investment theme. Key risk: Trump-Fed conflict escalating into policy incoherence.
